title: Night Prayer Before Sleep | Give God Your Worries, Rest in His Peace
description:
Tired body, racing mind? Give God every worry tonight, then fall asleep to Scripture read slowly over you: Psalm 91, Psalm 121, Psalm 23, Matthew 6 and more.

Chapters
0:00 Good morning
0:41 Lay me down in peace (Psalm 4:8)
1:35 Cast your cares (1 Peter 5:7)
2:32 Rest for your soul (Matthew 11:28-30)
3:30 Looking back with God
4:21 Forgiven tonight (1 John 1:9)
5:13 Ephesians 4:26
5:20 He never sleeps (Psalm 121:3-4)
6:12 Under his wings (Psalm 91:4-5)
6:48 Psalm 139:11-12
7:44 My peace I give you (John 14:27)
8:21 Sweet sleep (Proverbs 3:24)
8:53 Psalm 30:5
11:47 Psalm 127:2
11:58 The Lord is my shepherd (Psalm 23)
13:22 Declaration for tonight
13:41 Psalm 63:6
13:48 One thing to do tonight
14:05 Scripture for sleep
15:51 The Lord is thy keeper (Psalm 121)
17:06 Consider the lilies (Matthew 6:25-34)
19:37 Let not your heart be troubled (John 14:1-3)
20:32 He fainteth not (Isaiah 40:28-31)
21:51 The peace of God (Philippians 4:6-8)
23:04 Nothing can separate us (Romans 8:35-39)
24:26 New every morning (Lamentations 3:22-26)
25:15 Thou knowest my lying down (Psalm 139:1-10)
26:59 Under his wings (Psalm 91)
29:29 My rock and my refuge (Psalm 62:5-8)
30:22 Psalm 16:8-9, 11
31:29 Blessing

Scripture in this prayer: Psalm 4:8; 1 Peter 5:7; Matthew 11:28-30; 1 John 1:9; Ephesians 4:26; Psalm 121:3-4; Psalm 91:4-5; Psalm 139:11-12; John 14:27; Proverbs 3:24; Psalm 30:5; Psalm 127:2; Psalm 23; Psalm 63:6; Psalm 121; Matthew 6:25-34; John 14:1-3; Isaiah 40:28-31; Philippians 4:6-8; Romans 8:35, 37-39; Lamentations 3:22-26; Psalm 139:1-10; Psalm 91; Psalm 62:5-8; Psalm 16:8-9, 11; 2 Thessalonians 3:16

Scripture quotations: King James Version (public domain).
